# Amiya Islam

> Founding engineer and AI maximalist who loves building products from 0 to 1. Personal site: https://www.amiyaislam.com

## About
- Founding engineer at SWA AI (swa-ai.com), an enterprise AI platform: built the multi-agent platform teams use in Slack, Microsoft Teams, SMS, web and mobile, plus its enterprise controls, billing and multi-tenant data model.
- Before software: construction engineering (B.S., Virginia Tech) and a project engineer role at DPR Construction on a $100M civic build.
- Certifications: AWS DevOps Engineer Professional, AWS Security Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, Developer and SysOps Associate, CKA, LFCS, CompTIA Security+, Terraform Associate.
